items.title: 68145_Jimmie Rowles oral history interview
items.q: But I never got to know Pha Terrell.

ctx.x: Freddie Guy? Yeah. You mentioned earlier people like Dan Grissom and Pha Terrell with Andy Kirk's band. Jazz Critics, people who write about Jazz, have never had much use for those kind of singers. Naturally, everybody loves the way Louis sings, and we accept all the musicians who were singing, like Trummy and so on. But the sweet singers like that have really gotten a bit of a raw deal from all the things that you read in the history books. Now, in talking to musicians, you very often find that they like their…
Oh, they were my favorite singers! I think Dan Grissom and Pha Terrell, you couldn't top 'em.
And they had a lot to do also with the popularity of those bands, I think...
